phase_1_bench_validation.objective: Bench: SMP catheter segment in tissue phantom. Measure: controlled navigation accuracy, buckling behavior, tissue contact force, failure recovery.
phase_1_bench_validation.cost: $15-30K (ESTIMATED: SMP prototype + tissue phantom + force sensors)
phase_1_bench_validation.pass_criteria: Safe closed-loop navigation to target within 5mm accuracy AND tissue force < 0.01 N AND failure recovery demonstrated

phase_2_prototype.objective: Build functional prototype incorporating bench-validated mechanism

phase_3_relevant_environment.objective: Test in clinically relevant environment (cadaver, animal, or simulated)
